title: Ability to start libre 1 sensors (xDrip+bubbleDevice)
symptom: To start a Libre 1 sensor, the user needs to launch another application and start the sensor from there.
cause: The bubble device does not support starting the sensor from xDrip; it requires the bubble's own app.
fix: Ask the bubble developers to integrate the feature, or contact them directly.
evidence_quote: You have to ask the bubble developers to integrate this feature. As long as it is not supported by the bubble device, it cannot be supported by xDrip.
